SELECT ap.appeal_id, e.exam_id, e.exam_name, s.student_no, s.student_name, a.question_content, ap.appeal_status, CASE ap.appeal_status WHEN 0 THEN '待处理' WHEN 1 THEN '已通过' WHEN 2 THEN '已驳回' END AS appeal_status_name, ap.application_time, ap.review_time FROM t_exam_appeal ap INNER JOIN t_exam_answer a ON a.answer_id = ap.answer_id INNER JOIN t_exam_record r ON r.exam_record_id = a.exam_record_id INNER JOIN t_exam_exam e ON e.exam_id = r.exam_id INNER JOIN t_exam_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id
e.deleted_flag = b'0' AND e.semester_id = #{query.semesterId} AND e.course_id = #{query.courseId} AND e.exam_id = #{query.examId} AND ap.appeal_status = #{query.appealStatus}
AND (INSTR(s.student_no, #{query.studentKeyword}) OR INSTR(s.student_name, #{query.studentKeyword}))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ap.appeal_status = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ap.application_time ASC

SELECT ap.appeal_id, a.answer_id, r.exam_record_id, e.exam_id, e.exam_name, s.student_id, s.student_no, s.student_name, a.question_content, a.student_answer, a.ai_score, a.ai_comment, a.final_score, a.max_score, r.total_score AS exam_total_score, ap.appeal_reason, ap.appeal_status, CASE ap.appeal_status WHEN 0 THEN '待处理' WHEN 1 THEN '已通过' WHEN 2 THEN '已驳回' END AS appeal_status_name, ap.adjusted_score, ap.teacher_opinion, ap.application_time, ap.review_time FROM t_exam_appeal ap INNER JOIN t_exam_answer a ON a.answer_id = ap.answer_id INNER JOIN t_exam_record r ON r.exam_record_id = a.exam_record_id INNER JOIN t_exam_exam e ON e.exam_id = r.exam_id INNER JOIN t_exam_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE ap.appeal_id = #{appealId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_exam_appeal SET appeal_status = #{reviewResult}, adjusted_score = #{adjustedScore}, teacher_opinion = #{teacherOpinion}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = NOW() WHERE appeal_id = #{appealId} AND appeal_status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_exam_notice(student_id, title, content) SELECT r.student_id, '成绩复议处理结果', CONCAT('考试“', e.exam_name, '”的复议申请已', CASE ap.appeal_status WHEN 1 THEN '通过' ELSE '驳回' END, '。教师意见：', ap.teacher_opinion) FROM t_exam_appeal ap INNER JOIN t_exam_answer a ON a.answer_id = ap.answer_id INNER JOIN t_exam_record r ON r.exam_record_id = a.exam_record_id INNER JOIN t_exam_exam e ON e.exam_id = r.exam_id WHERE ap.appeal_id = #{appealId}
